description: Exactly how to call POST https://api.iomarkets.tech/v1/proof/execution, the paid best-execution audit: the body (pair, one of BTC-USDC, ETH-USDC, SOL-USDC, and fills: ts, fill_price, qty, side), the limits (fills per call, how old a fill may be, how close the market trade must be), the price, what comes back, and the answers that are not charged (400 for a bad body or an unsupported pair, 422 when no fill matches a trade). Give a draft body to check it with the API's own validation first. Read from the API's code; this tool calls nothing and pays nothing.
